main_text.p: tione reflexos, iplofque halitus contractivo motu cogentes, (velut à Luna contingere verofimile reddidimus,) vel faltem ob modum reflectionis peculiarem, quam difpofitio materiæ peculiaris in ea arbore infert, quo fit ut radii ita affecti non impediant, quo minus corpufcula exhalationum nitantur ad naturalem luum ftatum; ipfamque adeò nubem ita colligi in aquam: Eandem verò nubem, continue in guttas coeuntem, per affluentes vapores proximè vicinos continue foveri contingit, nova identidem materia è vicino marifubminiftrata. Sed quicquid fit, faltem apparet ex dictis, atque ex allegatis Experimentis liquido confiat, (ut concludamus cum Illuftr. Viro,) Aërem undiquaque atomis plenum effe, quæ beneficio luminis, ut ait, exinde refultantis à corporibus, attrahuntur, aut quæ ex illis promanant mediante calore naturali & infito ipforum motet corporum, qui eas propel-lit.

page.notes: Catchword reads "lit." at the foot; the empty foot paragraph above should be ignored. Pages with Latin text in roman type; Greek and italics absent except the italic "Aërem undiquaque atomis plenum effe" and "Viro" which are italic in the original (rendered with plain letters here). Some words in the first lines are uncertain at the scan edge.
